text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, good morning! Thanks to getting a 
solid rest, I'm bursting with energy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I used my time off to run all 
the way to the ocean!
choice_data_list: All the way to the sea?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There's nothing quite like the rush 
of sprinting straight toward the vast open 
sea!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, shouting our dreams 
toward the sunset made it the absolute 
best day off ever, ss!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, starting today, we're gonna heat 
things up with training again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Bamboo Memory was able to fully 
enjoy her day off.
